parsed_entries.requirement: Intermediaries must not steal, conceal, destroy, or alter computer source code used for a computer resource with the intention to cause damage.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the platform has policies in place to prevent unauthorized modification of computer source code.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to intermediaries handling computer resources.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines a criminal liability for unauthorized modification of computer source code.

parsed_entries.requirement: Sensitive personal data or information must be defined by the Central Government in consultation with relevant professional bodies or associations.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the organization has a defined policy for sensitive personal data or information as per the Central Government's prescription.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries handling personal data.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause mandates the definition of sensitive personal data by the Central Government.

parsed_entries.requirement: Intermediaries must maintain books of account or records as required by law.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the platform has policies in place to maintain required books of account or records.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to intermediaries required to maintain records.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines a penalty for failure to maintain required records.

parsed_entries.requirement: Intermediaries must file returns or furnish information within the time specified in regulations.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the platform has policies in place to ensure timely filing of returns or furnishing of information.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to intermediaries required to file returns or furnish information.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines a penalty for failure to file returns or furnish information within the specified time.

parsed_entries.requirement: Intermediaries must furnish documents, returns, or reports to the Controller or Certifying Authority as required.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the platform has policies in place to ensure timely furnishing of required documents, returns, or reports.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to intermediaries required to furnish documents, returns, or reports.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines a penalty for failure to furnish required documents, returns, or reports.
